Name: Hilltop Redux
Author: OrangeBurrito
Description:
[u][size=3][b]Features[/b][/size][/u]
[list]
[*]Replaces the Hilltop Farm
[*]Quarry is sunken in, instead of on a hill (like the definition actually says...)
[*]More wooded/grassy areas tucked away in the map corners, and a few large stumps

[*]A more natural-looking river bend and modified cliff-face for enhanced mountainous qualities.
[*](optional) bridge by the greenhouse for quick access to Grandpa's Shrine

[/list]
[u][size=3][b]Config
[/b][/size][/u]To enable the optional shrine bridge, change
"FromFile": "assets/hilltop.tbin" to
"FromFile": "assets/hilltop_bridge.tbin"
in content.json
[u][size=3][b]Installation[/b][/size][/u]
[list]
[*]Install SMAPI and Content Patcher
[*]Unzip and place into Mods folder
[*]Launch game with SMAPI
[/list]
Note: a tile by the middle bridge is bugged, and can't be walked through. I can't figure this out for the life of me, maybe in the next update.
